title: Cross-Platform Ultra-Cold Liquid Helium TEM Sample Holder with High Stability
content: Here, we introduce a novel ultra-cold transmission electron microscope sample holder cooled with liquid helium capable of atomic resolution stability. This custom holder can reach any temperature between room and base cryogenic temperatures (≥23 K) in scanning transmission electron microscopes (S/TEM) with ±2 mK thermal stability over a period of 10+ hours [1].
